In agreement with recently published studies on bronchioalveolar lavage fluid cells of patients with mild and severe COVID-19 5 , 6 , we show an inflammatory FCN1 + macrophage phenotype in patients with critical COVID-19, which shares similarities with our nrMa population.

Expressing pro-inflammatory mediators such as CCL2, CCL3, CCL20, CXCL1, CXCL3, CXCL10, IL8, IL1B and TNF , this macrophage subpopulation might contribute to excessive inflammation by promoting monocyte recruitment and differentiation.
